text: Let’s learn to read the beads! Every bead you push up to the bar counts.
Watch — I push one bead up to the bar.
One bead at the bar — that’s 1!
Now you — push one bead up to the bar.
Each bead adds one more. Count with me…
How many beads are at the bar? Count them, then tap the number.
This top bead is special — it’s worth 5 all by itself!
Now you — push the big top bead down. What number is that?
5 up here… and 1 more down here… 5 and 1 makes 6!
Your turn to read. How many is this?
You can read the beads now! High five!
